curated.category: 肝血管与消化大出血急症
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 各种原因（中国以乙肝肝硬化最常见）使肝脏变硬，流入肝脏的门静脉血流受阻、压力飙升，被迫在食管和胃底鼓起一条条薄如蝉翼的“曲张静脉”; 2) 虽然门脉高压本身慢性形成，但一旦曲张静脉破裂，患者会在数分钟至数小时内爆发喷射状大量呕血与柏油样黑便，迅速因失血性休克死亡，每次急性大出血的6周病死率仍高达15%–20%; 3) 门脉高压还会引发顽固性腹水、自发性腹膜炎与肝性脑病昏迷。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期无创筛查出临床显著门静脉高压（CSPH）并长期口服卡维地洛可有效降低门脉压力、预防首次出血和腹水失代偿；急性大出血可通过内镜下套扎/硬化止血及经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）迅速挽救生命；但彻底根治仍需针对病因（如抗乙肝/丙肝病毒）或在终末期行肝移植。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE将门静脉高压死亡合并计入肝硬化及其他慢性肝病（全球肝硬化年死亡约130万–140万例），曲张静脉破裂出血与肝衰竭是核心死因

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国肝硬化患者基数庞大（估算约700万例以上，以乙肝为主），门静脉高压相关消化道大出血与肝衰竭是国内肝病患者最主要死亡原因
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会肝病学分会《肝硬化门静脉高压食管胃静脉曲张出血防治指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 约80%–90%的肝硬化患者最终会发展为门静脉高压（Baveno VII 2022）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国约700万肝硬化人群中，临床显著门静脉高压及静脉曲张占绝大多数，CHESS门脉高压联盟正推进全国无创早筛

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 肝病患者一旦突发呕鲜血/咖啡样物、大量黑便、头晕心慌冷汗，立即拨打120禁食禁水，头偏向一侧防止血块窒息误吸; 2) 院内急救黄金三联：立即静脉泵注降门脉压血管活性药（生长抑素、奥曲肽或特利加压素）、静脉预防性广谱抗生素（头孢曲松等，防自发性腹膜炎与再出血）及限制性输血（维持血红蛋白70–80 g/L即可，切忌过度输血输液使门脉压力反弹冲开血痂）; 3) 12小时内急诊胃镜套扎或组织胶注射止血；若属Child-Pugh C级或高危Child-Pugh B级出血，应在72小时内尽早行抢先TIPS（经颈静脉肝内门体分流术）大幅降低死亡率。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: Baveno VII国际共识及中国CHESS门脉高压联盟在2023–2024年推动了两大范式变革：1) 确立肝脏硬度（LSM≥25 kPa）直接无创诊断临床显著门脉高压（CSPH）并早期启动卡维地洛，使失代偿事件发生率显著下降; 2) 中国CHESS多中心研究基于AI放射组学与无创血液模型实现虚拟肝静脉压力梯度（vHVPG）精准测算，替代有创插管检查，并进一步验证了早期抢先TIPS在乙肝肝硬化高危出血中的显著生存获益。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无获批的抗肝纤维化药物能直接逆转晚期肝硬化假小叶结构; 2) TIPS术后约20%–30%患者可能诱发肝性脑病，亟需更精准的分流直径控制与预防方案; 3) 基层肝病患者对定期胃镜或无创弹性筛查依从性仍不足。

master.definition_en: Carotid stenosis is a narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the carotid artery, usually caused by atherosclerosis. The internal carotid artery supplies the brain. Plaque often builds up at that division, and causes a narrowing (stenosis). Pieces of plaque can break off and block the small arteries above in the brain, which causes a stroke. Plaque can also build up at the origin of the carotid artery at the aorta.

master.definition_en: Waters-West syndrome is characterized by the association of lethal non-spherocytic, non-immune hemolytic anemia with abnormalities of the external genitalia (micropenis and hypospadias), flat occiput, dimpled earlobes, deep plantar creases, and increased space between the first and second toes. It has been described only once in two brothers who died a few hours after birth. The second-born infant had massive ascites and hepatosplenomegaly. The mother had two spontaneous abortions (at 6 and 12 weeks gestation) but gave birth to a normal girl, suggesting an autosomal or X-linked recessive mode of inheritance. Although the parents were not known to be consanguineous, they shared a French-Canadian and American Indian ethnic origin.
synonyms_en: hemolytic anaemia lethal congenital nonspherocytic with genital and other abnormalities
hemolytic anemia lethal congenital nonspherocytic with genital and other abnormalities

master.definition_en: Visual snow syndrome is described as a persistent visual problem characterized by seeing snow-like dots. Migraines are a common symptom. Many people also see drifting blobs of varying size and shape (floaters), visual effects (entopic phenomenon), glare, halos, starbursts, trails, odd colors and shapes, and may have persistent recurrence of a visual image (palinopsia) and double vision. Additional symptoms may include fatigue, tinnitus, or depersonalization and depression. Most people have normal vision tests and normal brain images. Standard migraine treatments are often not helpful. There is no cure or effective treatment to completely relieve the symptoms, but medication seems to help some people with visual snow.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

master.definition_en: A rare multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by a large omphalocele containing liver and small intestine, diaphragmatic hernia, cardiovascular anomalies (e. g. aortic coarctation), variable limb malformations (including radioulnar synostosis, agenesis of the radius and/or thumb, generalized syndactyly, and numerical reduction of toes), and dysmorphic facial features. Additional reported manifestations are unilateral absence of umbilical artery, intestinal malrotation, hypoplastic ovaries, and unilateral renal agenesis, among others. The condition is mostly fatal in the neonatal period.

master.definition_en: A rare form of hemochromatosis characterized by inappropriately regulated intestinal iron absorption which leads to excessive iron storage in various organs and manifests with a wide range of signs and symptoms, including abdominal pain, weakness, lethargy, weight loss, elevated serum aminotransferase levels, increase in skin pigmentation, and/or arthropathy in the metacarpophalangeal joints. Other commonly associated manifestations include hepatomegaly, cirrhosis, liver fibrosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, restrictive cardiomyopathy and/or diabetes mellitus.
